WriteLite — Third-Party Notices
================================

This file documents open-source components that may be bundled with WriteLite
as internal runtime dependencies. It is a legal/technical notice for
distributors and developers. It is not shown in the main application UI.

WriteLite uses third-party components with open source licenses. Full license
texts and copyright notices are retained in the packaged files listed below.
WriteLite authors do not claim authorship of these third-party components.


1) Language checking runtime (bundled under ThirdParty/LanguageEngine/6.4)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  Component name: LanguageTool
  Version:        6.4
  Homepage:       https://languagetool.org
  Copyright:      Copyright (C) 2005-2024 the LanguageTool community and
                  Daniel Naber (www.danielnaber.de), and other contributors
                  as indicated in the upstream distribution.

  Primary license:
    GNU Lesser General Public License (LGPL), Version 2.1
    (or later terms as stated by the upstream project).

  Local license / notice files (relative to this application package):
    - ThirdParty/LanguageEngine/6.4/COPYING.txt
    - ThirdParty/LanguageEngine/6.4/README.md
    - ThirdParty/LanguageEngine/6.4/third-party-licenses/
    - ThirdParty/LanguageEngine/6.4/third-party-licenses/README.txt
    - ThirdParty/LanguageEngine/6.4/third-party-licenses/LGPL-2.1.txt
    - and other license texts in third-party-licenses/

  Notes:
    - The component is used as a local, offline internal dependency of
      WriteLite (local process / localhost only when enabled by WriteLite).
    - Bundled JAR files and language resources are copies of the upstream
      distribution and were not modified by the WriteLite authors at the
      time of packaging.
    - Individual libraries and language resources used by this component
      may be under different licenses (Apache-2.0, MIT, BSD, EPL, CPL, and
      others). See third-party-licenses/README.txt and the license files in
      third-party-licenses/ for details.
    - Technical package and file names under ThirdParty/LanguageEngine are
      retained as required for runtime compatibility. They are not intended
      as product branding in the WriteLite user interface.


2) Local AI — WriteLite-Qwen base models (optional shipped weights)
-------------------------------------------------------------------

  When a neural model pack is distributed under models/writelight-qwen/, it is
  derived from the Qwen instruct family (fine-tuned for WriteLite GEC):

  Component name: Qwen2.5 (0.5B Instruct) / optional Qwen3-0.6B
  Product name:   WriteLite-Qwen-0.6B-GEC
  Homepage:       https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct
  License:        Apache License 2.0
  Notes:
    - Fine-tuned LoRA adapter / merged weights / GGUF may be packaged separately.
    - Default app path works without these weights (rules + spell + LanguageTool + Lite engine).
    - Retain Apache-2.0 notices when redistributing model files.
    - Runtime prefers local GGUF + llama-server (loopback only) or developer local endpoint.

  Optional Quality base:
  Component name: Qwen ~1.5B–1.7B Instruct
  License:        Apache License 2.0 (confirm exact card before shipping)



3) Document engine libraries (WriteLite.Documents)
--------------------------------------------------

  These are managed .NET libraries used to read and write document formats.
  All run entirely in-process on the local machine; none of them opens a
  network connection or transmits document content.

  Component name: DocumentFormat.OpenXml
  Version:        3.5.1
  Homepage:       https://github.com/dotnet/Open-XML-SDK
  Copyright:      Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation
  License:        MIT License
  Used for:       Reading and writing .docx (WordprocessingML) packages.

  Component name: PdfPig
  Version:        0.1.15
  Homepage:       https://github.com/UglyToad/PdfPig
  Copyright:      Copyright (c) UglyToad and PdfPig contributors
  License:        Apache License 2.0
  Used for:       Extracting text and glyph positions from .pdf files.
  Notes:          Fully managed; no native binaries are bundled.

  Component name: PDFsharp
  Version:        6.2.4
  Homepage:       https://docs.pdfsharp.net/
  Copyright:      Copyright (c) empira Software GmbH and PDFsharp contributors
  License:        MIT License
  Used for:       Generating .pdf output. Page layout is WriteLite's own code;
                  only the drawing and PDF-writing surface of PDFsharp is used.

  Transitive packages pulled in by the above (all MIT, from Microsoft):
    System.IO.Packaging, Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions,
    Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Abstractions,
    System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs

  OpenDocument (.odt) support is implemented directly by WriteLite over the
  .NET base class library (System.IO.Compression and System.Xml.Linq) and
  introduces no third-party dependency.

  Font embedding: PDF export embeds TrueType/OpenType faces found in the
  operating system's font directories so that Cyrillic and other non-Latin
  text renders correctly. WriteLite does not redistribute font files; it reads
  the fonts already installed on the user's machine at export time. Any
  redistribution of a resulting PDF is subject to the embedding terms of the
  fonts the user selected.


4) Other WriteLite dependencies
-------------------------------

  Additional .NET packages used by WriteLite (if any) are declared in project
  files and may carry their own licenses via NuGet package metadata.

  Application icon and other original WriteLite assets are not covered by
  the notices above.

  WriteLite local Lite rules (embedded lite-rules.json) are original WriteLite
  content, not third-party model weights.


5) Source of the bundled LanguageTool runtime
---------------------------------------------

  Bundled snapshot corresponds to upstream LanguageTool distribution version
  6.4, packaged under:

    ThirdParty/LanguageEngine/6.4/

  If you distribute WriteLite with this runtime, you must retain this file
  and the referenced COPYING / third-party-licenses materials.
